market_view: VIX is calm at 14.9 (down 13% in 5 days) after the Fed hike; the 10-year is near 5.0% and the dollar is firm. Tech rebounded sharply (semi ETF +4% on the day, +10% in 5 days); oil fell hard on the day.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI -4.5% on the day is already priced in. The only oil headline is a Zacks blog on Valero, Phillips 66 and Eni mentioning a Xi visit to Washington, with no XOM-specific cause. No named catalyst.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold is -6% in 20 days with yields near highs and a firm dollar. No NEM, production or guidance headline; the gold-themed items are unrelated stories.

chips.reasoning: The semi ETF +4% and AMD +10% on the day are already in price. Headlines are promotional (NVDA 10-year return piece, Zacks blog), with no guidance or export-rule change. Chasing a rebound is not a catalyst.

pharma.reasoning: LLY is 9% below its high after a 20-day dip, but there is no trial, regulator or pricing headline. Nothing pharma-specific in the record.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper +5.6% in 5 days is already priced in. No FCX, supply outage or China-data headline, and the uranium ETF is below its 200-day average without a cause.

would_change_my_mind: A named headline on XOM (OPEC+ or Hormuz), NEM guidance, an NVDA guidance or export-rule change, an LLY trial or pricing item, or an FCX/copper supply outage or China data.

handoff.what_changed: Five days since the 09-17 note. WTI fell 4.5% on 09-21 and XOM fell 3.2%. Tech rebounded: the semi ETF rose 4% on the day and 10% in 5 days, and AMD rose 10%. Copper rose 5.6% in 5 days. Headlines were again noise with no named catalyst, so all five families stay flat.

oil_gas.why: WTI drop is priced in; no XOM-specific headline.

gold_miners.why: Yields near highs and a firm dollar; no NEM headline.

chips.why: Sharp rebound already priced in; no NVDA guidance or export-rule headline.

pharma.why: No LLY trial, regulator or pricing headline.

copper_uranium.why: Copper rally priced in; no FCX or China-data headline.
